description: Write a DataFrame to a Databricks Delta Lake table.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame

host_env_var.label: Host Env Var
host_env_var.description: Env var containing Databricks workspace URL

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var containing Databricks personal access token

cluster_id.label: Cluster Id
cluster_id.description: SQL warehouse or cluster ID (None = auto)

drop_timezone.label: Drop Timezone
drop_timezone.description: Drop tz from tz-aware datetime columns before INSERT. Default true because the parameterized INSERT path doesn't bind tz cleanly. Set false if your tables use TIMESTAMP and you've handled tz upstream.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key (e.g. 'event_date', 'created_at').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value (e.g. 'customer_id', 'region').

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the DataFrame about to be written, in metadata, so builder UIs can show 'what's being sunk' without warehouse access.
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows in the preview when include_preview_metadata=True. Random sample if len > 10x preview_rows; else head.
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.
description.label: Description

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream columns it derives from, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in ONE run: the upstream frame (loaded once, spanning the whole range) is filtered to every partition key in the range via Partition Date Column/Partition Static Column and written together. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set. Requires a partition-range-aware IO manager for the upstream asset (e.g. a DB-table IO manager with partition_expr set, or InMemoryIOManager in tests) -- a generic filesystem IO manager cannot persist/load a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and raises a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional key of a registered DatabricksSqlResourceComponent (resources/databricks_sql_resource). When set, connection credentials are read from that resource at run time instead of the inline connection fields above (lets one credential serve several components). Leave empty to use the inline fields. Catalog, schema and table stay configured on this component.

name: DataFrame to Databricks
